command: llvm-mc -triple=x86_64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0102/probe.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: The three 0.66.0 sub rows: REX.W 83 /5 ib (48 83 e8 01 / 48 83 e8 80 / 49 83 e8 01), REX.W 81 /5 id (48 81 eb 2c 01 00 00 / 49 81 ef ff ff ff 7f / 48 81 ea 00 00 00 80) and REX.W 2d id (48 2d 2c 01 00 00 / 48 2d ff ff ff 7f / 48 2d 00 00 00 80). llvm-mc picks the accumulator for subq $300, %rax, which is EC-04's counterexample; subq $1, %r8 shows the dest slot's REX.B bit (49, not 48). input_sha256 is probe.asm; output_sha256 is the 55-byte .text.
